extra_vocab.en: worried that something bad may happen
extra_vocab.note: 文中指部分人員對颱風天出差感到不安。語氣比 afraid 輕，常用在對未來的事情有點擔心時，後面多接 about。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: apprehensive 後面常接 about + 名詞或 V-ing，也可接 that 子句；介系詞用 about，不用 for。

example.en: Some new hires feel apprehensive about speaking in front of clients.
example.zh: 有些新進員工對在客戶面前發言感到憂慮。

example.en: The team was apprehensive about the outcome of the contract negotiation.
example.zh: 團隊擔心合約協商的結果。

example.en: He gave the auditor an apprehensive look before opening the files.
example.zh: 他打開檔案前，向稽核員投以憂慮的眼神。

examples.en: Several staff members felt apprehensive about the sudden change in schedule.
examples.zh: 幾位員工對突然的行程變動感到憂慮。

examples.en: The manager looked apprehensive as she opened the quarterly sales report.
examples.zh: 經理打開季度銷售報告時顯得憂心忡忡。

examples.en: Many travelers are apprehensive about flying during bad weather.
examples.zh: 許多旅客對在惡劣天氣下搭機感到不安。

confusable.diff: 拼法很像，但 comprehensive 是「全面的、完整的」，和擔心無關。

example.en: We offer a comprehensive insurance plan for all full-time employees.
example.zh: 我們為所有全職員工提供全面的保險方案。

similar.diff: nervous 較口語，常指上台或面試前的緊張；apprehensive 較正式，多指擔心未來的結果。

example.en: I was nervous before my first presentation to the board.
example.zh: 我在第一次向董事會簡報前很緊張。

similar.diff: worried 最常用、語氣最直接；apprehensive 帶有預感不妙的意味，較書面。

example.en: She is worried that the shipment will arrive late.
example.zh: 她擔心貨物會延遲到達。

example.en: Customers are anxious to hear about the refund policy.
example.zh: 客戶急著想知道退款政策。

example.en: Some employees felt uneasy about the proposed merger.
example.zh: 有些員工對合併提案感到不安。

example.en: The board is concerned about rising shipping costs.
example.zh: 董事會擔心運費不斷上漲。

derived.link: apprehensive 去掉 -ive 改成 -ion，變成名詞「擔心」，像 tension、decision 的字尾

extra_vocab.zh: 薪資名冊、員工名單；薪資總額
extra_vocab.en: a list of the people who work for a company and get paid by it
extra_vocab.note: 文中 on the payroll 指「在公司編制內領薪的員工」，所以這些人都受公司旅遊保險保障。這個說法強調員工身分正式、有領薪水。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: on the payroll 的介系詞固定用 on，不說 in the payroll；payroll 也常放在名詞前當修飾，如 payroll department。

example.en: Both subsidiaries manage their payrolls through the same software system.
example.zh: 兩家子公司透過同一套軟體系統管理各自的薪資作業。

collocations.zh: 受雇於公司、列入薪資名單

example.en: We added three engineers to the payroll last quarter.
example.zh: 我們上一季新增了三名工程師到編制內。

example.en: Please send your bank details to the payroll department.
example.zh: 請把你的銀行帳戶資料寄給薪資部門。

example.en: The new payroll system reduced errors in monthly salary payments.
example.zh: 新的薪資系統減少了每月發薪的錯誤。

example.en: The startup struggled to meet payroll during its first year.
example.zh: 這家新創公司第一年很難籌出員工薪水。

examples.en: All full-time staff members are currently on the company payroll.
examples.zh: 所有全職員工目前都在公司編制內。

examples.en: The finance team processes the payroll on the last day of every month.
examples.zh: 財務團隊在每月最後一天處理薪資。

examples.en: Payroll is the largest expense for most service companies.
examples.zh: 薪資是多數服務業公司最大的支出。

confusable.diff: paycheck 是個人領到的薪水（支票或入帳）；payroll 是公司全體員工的薪資名冊或總額。

example.en: Your paycheck will be deposited into your account every Friday.
example.zh: 你的薪水每週五會存入你的帳戶。

confusable.diff: salary 是個人的固定薪資金額；payroll 指整個公司的發薪名單或總支出。

example.en: Her annual salary increased by five percent after the promotion.
example.zh: 她升職後年薪增加了百分之五。

similar.diff: on staff 泛指是公司的在職員工；on the payroll 強調列入薪資名單、有領薪水。

example.en: Our firm has six full-time accountants on staff.
example.zh: 我們公司有六位全職會計師在職。

example.en: The factory raised the hourly wage for night shift workers.
example.zh: 工廠提高了夜班員工的時薪。

example.en: Every employee received a year-end bonus this December.
example.zh: 今年十二月每位員工都領到了年終獎金。

example.en: Health insurance is one of the main benefits we provide.
example.zh: 健康保險是我們提供的主要福利之一。

senses.en: a list of the workers a company employs and pays

example.en: Only permanent employees appear on the company's official payroll list.
example.zh: 只有正式員工會出現在公司的正式薪資名單上。

senses.en: the total amount of money a company pays its workers
senses.distinguish: 看到 rising、cut、reduce 等和金額一起出現時，通常是「薪資總額」；看到 on the payroll 則是「員工名單」。

example.en: Rising labor costs pushed our monthly payroll above budget.
example.zh: 人力成本上升，使我們每月的薪資總額超出預算。

extra_vocab.en: the kind of work a person does to earn money
extra_vocab.note: 文中指入境卡上要填寫的「職業」欄位。occupation 是表格和官方文件常用的正式字，日常聊天多說 job。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示「職業」時是可數名詞（填表常寫 What is your occupation?）；表示「占用、入住」時是不可數名詞。

example.en: Teaching and nursing are among the most respected occupations in the country.
example.zh: 教學和護理是該國最受尊敬的職業之一。

example.en: Applicants must state their occupation on the visa application.
example.zh: 申請人必須在簽證申請表上填寫職業。

example.en: Welding is a skilled occupation with strong demand.
example.zh: 焊接是需求強勁的技術性職業。

example.en: Students should explore different fields before they choose an occupation.
example.zh: 學生在選擇職業前應該先探索不同領域。

examples.en: Please write your name, address, and occupation on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填寫姓名、地址和職業。

examples.en: The survey asked respondents about their age, income, and occupation.
examples.zh: 這份調查詢問受訪者的年齡、收入和職業。

examples.en: The lease allows occupation of the warehouse starting in July.
examples.zh: 租約允許從七月起使用這座倉庫。

confusable.diff: 字尾 -ation 和發音很像，但 vacation 是「假期」，和工作種類無關。

example.en: Employees can take a paid vacation after one year of service.
example.zh: 員工服務滿一年後可以請有薪假。

similar.diff: job 口語、指一份具體的工作；occupation 較正式，用在表格與統計。

example.en: She found a good job at a logistics company.
example.zh: 她在一家物流公司找到了好工作。

similar.diff: profession 指需要專業訓練或資格的職業，如律師、醫師；occupation 範圍更廣。

example.en: Law is a profession that requires years of training.
example.zh: 法律是需要多年訓練的專業職業。

example.en: She built a successful career in the shipping industry.
example.zh: 她在航運業打造了成功的職涯。

example.en: The company has an open position in accounting.
example.zh: 公司在會計部門有一個職缺。

derived.link: occupation 去掉 -ation 就是 occupy，像 apply → application

senses.en: the kind of work a person does to earn money

example.en: Her occupation is listed as marketing consultant on the registration form.
example.zh: 她的職業在登記表上寫的是行銷顧問。

senses.en: the act of living or working in a building or place
senses.distinguish: 和 building、office、apartment 等地點一起出現時，指「入住、使用」，不是職業。

example.en: The tenants took occupation of the new office last week.
example.zh: 租戶上週搬進了新辦公室。

extra_vocab.en: in a way that shows good judgment
extra_vocab.note: 文中 wisely 表達寫信者對委員會決定的正面評價：延後出發是明智之舉。這種放在動詞前、帶評價意味的副詞，在正式公告裡很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: wisely 放在助動詞和過去分詞之間（has wisely decided），表示對整個決定的評價；放句尾（decided wisely）則只描述做法。

example.en: Please choose wisely, because this vendor will serve us for years.
example.zh: 請明智選擇，因為這家供應商會長期為我們服務。

example.en: Companies that invest wisely in training often keep their best staff.
example.zh: 明智投資在培訓上的公司，通常能留住最好的員工。

example.en: Using your time wisely helps you finish tasks before the deadline.
example.zh: 善用時間能幫助你在截止日前完成工作。

example.en: The committee acted wisely by consulting the legal team first.
example.zh: 委員會先諮詢法務團隊，做法十分明智。

examples.en: The board wisely chose to wait until the market became stable.
examples.zh: 董事會明智地選擇等到市場穩定後再行動。

examples.en: We should spend our marketing budget wisely this quarter.
examples.zh: 我們這一季應該明智地運用行銷預算。

examples.en: She wisely asked for a written contract before starting the project.
examples.zh: 她在開始專案前明智地要求書面合約。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音很像，但 widely 是「廣泛地」，不是「明智地」。

example.en: This software is widely used in the logistics industry.
example.zh: 這套軟體在物流業被廣泛使用。

similar.diff: sensibly 強調合乎常理、不浮誇；wisely 強調有判斷力、有遠見，語氣更正面。

example.en: The manager sensibly kept some funds aside for emergencies.
example.zh: 經理合理地預留了一些資金以備緊急之需。

similar.diff: with good judgment 是較長的說法，常放句尾；wisely 是單字，可放在動詞前。

example.en: She handled the complaint with good judgment and patience.
example.zh: 她以良好的判斷力和耐心處理了這項客訴。

example.en: The supplier offered a reasonable price for bulk orders.
example.zh: 供應商對大量訂單提出了合理的價格。

example.en: Be careful when you enter the customer data.
example.zh: 輸入客戶資料時請小心。

example.en: Thank you for your thoughtful comments on the proposal.
example.zh: 謝謝你對提案提出的深思熟慮的意見。

derived.link: wisely 去掉 -ly 就是形容詞 wise；形容詞加 -ly 變副詞，像 quick → quickly
wise + -dom，表示狀態或領域，像 freedom、kingdom
un- 表示否定，加在 wise 前，像 unhappy、unable

extra_vocab.en: a long space inside a building with rooms on its sides
extra_vocab.note: 文中請大家抵達飯店後在大廳旁的走廊集合。hallway 指建築物內連接各房間的通道，常用來描述集合或指引地點。

example.en: The hotel's hallways were quiet after the evening conference ended.
example.zh: 晚間會議結束後，飯店的走廊很安靜。

example.en: A few colleagues were chatting in the hallway after lunch.
example.zh: 午餐後有幾位同事在走廊上聊天。

example.en: Signs along the hallway direct visitors to each department.
example.zh: 走廊沿途的標示會引導訪客前往各部門。

example.en: The narrow hallway made it hard to move the heavy boxes.
example.zh: 狹窄的走廊讓搬運重箱子變得很困難。

example.en: The restrooms are just down the hallway on your left.
example.zh: 洗手間就在走廊前方的左手邊。

examples.en: Please leave your luggage in the hallway outside the meeting room.
examples.zh: 請把行李放在會議室外的走廊上。

examples.en: The photocopier is located at the end of the hallway.
Keep the hallway clear so everyone can exit safely during a fire.
examples.zh: 請保持走廊暢通，火災時大家才能安全離開。

confusable.diff: hall 可指大廳、會堂，也可指走廊；hallway 專指建築物內的通道。

example.en: The annual meeting will be held in the main hall.
example.zh: 年度會議將在主禮堂舉行。

confusable.diff: aisle 是座位之間或貨架之間的通道；hallway 是建築物內連接房間的走廊。

example.en: Please keep the aisle clear so staff can walk through.
example.zh: 請保持走道暢通，讓員工可以通行。

similar.diff: corridor 較正式，常指長而連接多個空間的走廊；hallway 也可指入口處的通道。

example.en: Offices line both sides of the long corridor on the third floor.
example.zh: 三樓長長的走廊兩側都是辦公室。

example.en: Visitors must sign in at the front lobby before entering.
example.zh: 訪客進入前必須先在大廳簽到。

example.en: The main entrance will be closed for repairs next week.
example.zh: 主入口下週將因維修而關閉。

example.en: Use the stairway if the elevator is out of service.
example.zh: 電梯停用時請走樓梯。
